$comment: What Marvi can install. Data, not code — adding a component means adding an entry here. Voice models live in voice-models.json until the PowerShell installers are retired, because duplicating their hashes is how two files drift apart.

components.name: livekit
components.title: LiveKit server
components.why: Carries the voice session. Not needed if LIVEKIT_URL points at a cloud project.

extra.note: The release ships a zip; sizes and hashes are filled in when the download flow is proven against it.

components.name: vision-faces
components.title: Face recognition (buffalo_l)
components.why: Recognises you and tells a known face from a visitor.

extra.note: InsightFace downloads this itself on first use; listed here so Doctor can report on it and so removal is honest.

components.name: gateway-python
components.title: Gateway dependencies
components.why: The Gateway will not start without them.

components.name: agent-python
components.title: Voice agent dependencies
components.why: The voice worker will not start without them.

extra.note: Installs PyTorch. The CPU wheel on a GPU machine is the mistake this flags.

components.name: playwright-browsers
components.title: Browser engine (Chromium)
components.why: Browser tools cannot open a page without it.

extra.note: Roughly 150 MB, downloaded by Playwright itself into its own cache.

components.name: playwright-deps
components.title: Browser system libraries
components.why: Chromium needs them on Linux; a no-op on Windows.

components.name: voice-tts-voices
components.title: TTS speaker voices
components.why: The voice Marvi speaks in. Without them the TTS model has nothing to sound like.

extra.note: A git checkout of a subdirectory, not a file download - the only component the new installer cannot yet fetch, and the reason scripts/setup-voice-models.ps1 is still the supported path for voice.
